template-signature: Signature: Big light number with the status under it, a pill-centred wheel on the right, tinted mode buttons.
template-mission: Mission Control: Setpoint bar with flags and ticks under the number. Round icon-only modes up top, preset and fan as menus below.
template-tap: Tap & Go: Calm until you need it: tap the temperature or a pill and the wheel takes the number’s place, then folds away after 6 s.
template-slim: Slim Strip: One short centred row: name and number with a small stepper beside them, every set as a menu.
template-rail: Side Rail: Modes stacked down the left as outlined circles, a vertical setpoint bar on the right, preset and fan menus below.
template-wall: Wall Tablet: Big and finger-friendly: huge number, large wheel under it with three next values, chunky filled mode tiles.
template-glass: Minimal Glass: No card background or border, no labels: just the number, a stepper and text-only mode buttons.
template-neon: Neon: A cyan-to-pink gradient bar above the number with diamond handles, square filled buttons and an accent border.
template-pocket: Pocket: Phone-sized: small number, tiny stepper on the left, everything else behind round toggles along the top.
template-lava: Lava Lamp: Molten blobs rise while heating and sink while cooling, behind frosted menus and a big light number.
template-aurora: Northern Lights: Aurora ribbons that drift with the system, a gradient bar under the number, and ghost buttons.
template-frost: Frosted Glass: A soft light beam behind frosted glass controls, with a vignette and fine grain.
feature-reveal-open: Tap to reveal: open in place of the temperature
feature-bar: Setpoint bar with flags, ticks and current marker
feature-effects: Effects while heating: card, setpoint value, pill, mode button and icon glow
feature-vertical-gradient: Vertical gradient bar, flags on the right, no handle border
feature-fan-chips: RF fan chips: Breeze level, light, timer, speed 4/10
background-lava: Lava Lamp: heating, blobs rising from the pool
background-beam: Glow Beam: cooling, with vignette and grain
background-plasma-fan: Fan Only: swirling blades at the fan speed
